dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Help! I've chopped my leg off...
{YOU DID WHAT?} You've chopped off your leg?
dialogOption.COMMENT: doesnt look good in clickable dialog

dialogOption.texten: {WHERE ARE YOU?} Ok, where are you calling from?
At [[ADDRESS]]
At Cooper Avenue 321
At Jefferson Street 246
At Maple Street 179
{HOUSE OR APARTMENT?} Is that a house or an apartment?
There is a workshop... behind the house... it's open, I'm near the entrance.
{I'LL SEND AN AMBULANCE} OK, the ambulance is on the way... Tell me what happened ?
I helped my cousin in the workshop, pushed wood with my leg and slipped into the press! I can not take it out!
{IS HE NEARBY?} Is your cousin nearby?
No, he went after the goods... he will come back in the evening! There's no one around!
{HELP IS ON THE WAY} Keep calm. The ambulance is on the way... it will be there in a few minutes.
{TIE SOMETHING AROUND IT} Do you have something to tie around your leg?
No, just some tools... an axe and a hammer....
{TAKE OFF YOUR SHIRT} Alright, Take off your shirt then...
{MAKE A TOURNIQUET}Take off your shirt, tear it up if necessary, and firmly tie it around your leg, just above your injury.
{CALM DOWN} Good. I know this won't be easy but I need you to calmly breathe, relax. The ambulance will arrive soon.
God... I think I'm passing out....
{KEEP TALKING TO ME} No you're not... keep talking to me! Tell me, do you have a girlfriend?
I have a fiancee... we were going to get married in two months. . . . . . . . . . . . . God, please let it end now...
{YOU'LL BE FINE} You are gonna be fine, I need you to stay awake.
Please tell her that I loved her. Will you? As if... if I pass away here. Say that I thought about her, I beg you. You promise?
{I DO} Yes, I promise.
{YOU'LL TELL HER} But you will tell her yourself. The ambulance is almost there.
{HANG UP} ...
Oh God... it feels terrible...
Help me....

reportElement.texten: The caller has cut his leg during working in a workshop.
The caller fainted, because he lost too much blood.
The operator gave proper first aid instruction.
